TD12/001EN
Super Dimensional Robo, Daikaiser
Normal Unit｜ Dimension Police｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield -
[AUTO][Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):[Counter-Blast 1] When a <Dimension Police> rides this unit, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose your vanguard, and until end of turn, that unit gets [Power] +10000/[Critical] +1, and "[AUTO](VC):When this unit's drive check reveals a grade 3 <Dimension Police>, choose one of your opponent's guardians, retire it, and that unit's effects with "cannot be hit" is nullified.".
[AUTO](VC):When this unit is boosted([Boost]) by a <Dimension Police>, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a same clan as this unit, this unit cannot attack)
